2   CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT




    Dear Shareholders,

    In 2020, the COVID-19 pandemic spread over the world, and domestic and foreign markets were affected to varying degrees.
    Meanwhile, as China had been deepening reforms of the pharmaceutical and health systems, the relevant systems of policies
    and regulations were further amended and improved. Under the background of the coexistence of challenges and opportunities
    in the industry, the Group found “opportunities” from the new “crises”, overcame difficulties and moved forward steadily.
    Through the hard work of all employees, the Group further achieved high-quality sustainable development and successfully
    completed its annual business goals.

    In this year, the Group reshaped its corporate culture and value, upheld the mission of “prioritizing the quality of life of the
    patients” with the goal of “becoming a leading pharmaceutical enterprise within the industry”, insisted on “back to square
    one and start all over again” as the core of development and focused on its principal businesses in innovative medicines, in
    order to continuously strengthen its advantages in innovative medicines and complex drug preparation platforms with high
    barriers, break through higher growth barriers and strive to achieve high-quality enterprise development. Meanwhile, after
    the outbreak of COVID-19 pandemic, the Group united as one and cooperated with frontline medical workers, responded
    and took actions immediately, and successively donated cash and medicines worth more than RMB16 million to Red Cross
    Society of Zhuhai, Wuhan and other places. In addition, during the fight against the “epidemic”, the Group has not stopped
    its paces of targeted poverty alleviation and chronic disease poverty alleviation. At present, the Group has launched chronic
    disease poverty alleviation projects in “eleven counties and one township” in six provinces including Gansu, Sichuan, Shanxi,
    Jilin, Tibet and Henan, which has helped many poor families out of troubles of diseases and illuminated the light of hope
    for sick families in financial difficulties with the spirit of Healthy China Action.



    Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc. Annual Report 2020

REVIEW OF 2020
In 2020, the Group realized operating income of RMB10,520.41 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 12.10%;
the net profit was RMB2,131.33 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 45.82%; the net profit attributable to
shareholders of the Company was RMB1,714.91 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 31.63%; excluding gains
and losses from extraordinary items, the net profit attributable to shareholders of the Company generated from principal
operations of the Company in 2020 was RMB1,431.55 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 20.14%.

Based on the operating results and overall financial position of the Group for 2020, the Board proposed a profit distribution
plan of the Group for 2020 as follows: it is expected to distribute cash dividend of RMB12.50 (tax inclusive) for every 10
shares to all Shareholders of the Company on 25 June 2021, based on the Company’s total share capital (excluding the shares
of the Company which were repurchased but not yet cancelled) as at the registration date of shareholding as determined by
implementation of the 2020 annual profit distribution plan. There will be no bonus shares, nor will the capital reserves be
capitalized. The profit distribution plan for 2020 was still subject to consideration and approval at the 2020 annual general
meeting of the Company.




                                                                        Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc. Annual Report 2020
4   CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT



    In 2020, the Group’s key products in each business segment continued to exert strength. Among major chemical drug
    preparation products, the sales of Ilaprazole Sodium for Injection (注射用艾普拉唑鈉) increased rapidly year-on-year, and
    the sales of Leuprorelin Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸亮丙瑞林微球), Perospirone Hydrochloride Tablets
    (鹽酸哌羅匹隆片) and Fluvoxamine Maleate Tablets (馬來酸氟伏沙明片) achieved sustained and substantial increases
    year-on-year; Moreover, Anti-viral Granules (抗病毒顆粒), a major traditional Chinese drug preparation product, achieved
    a significant increase in sales driven by the pandemic compared to the previous year; and diagnostics kits for antibody to
    novel coronavirus (新型冠狀病毒抗體檢測試劑) achieved additional sales, resulting in a steady growth in the Company’s
    overall performance under the influence of the COVID-19 pandemic. At the end of 2020, two types of COVID-19 diagnostic
    products also received the European Union CE certification, which further expanded the supply of diagnostics kits to novel
    coronavirus, and also enabled the Group’s products to better meet the needs of global epidemic prevention and control.

    At present, the Group has entered a new stage of innovation-driven development. Ilaprazole series (艾普拉唑系列) products
    (innovative medicines) and Leuprorelin Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸亮丙瑞林微球) (a high-barrier
    complex drug preparation) continue to grow at a high rate, the contribution of which to the percentage of revenue and profit
    of the Group increased further, and both drivers have become powerful engines for the rapid development of the Group.
    In addition, the varieties and businesses from platforms including biologics and microspheres in the Group’s R&D pipelines
    have also injected new vitality into our business development.

    Our biologics R&D pipeline involves drugs based on new antibodies, multi-specific antibodies and recombinant protein in the
    areas of tumors, reproduction and immune diseases; meanwhile, we are also constantly advancing the platform construction
    including ADC technology platform and new CAR-T technology platform; and we are also in close cooperation with domestic
    macromolecular biologics R&D companies, world-class scientists, American cutting-edge cell therapy companies and Institute
    of Biophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (中國科學院生物物理研究所), and are accelerating clinical advancement of
    multiple products under research. In addition, with regard to the complex drug preparation platforms with high barriers, we
    will continue to expand our leading edges in the field of domestic microsphere innovation and R&D by developing a series
    of rich varieties under research, including many key varieties with high sales potential. The Group has also gathered top
    talents in this field and obtained special incentives from the nation for major new drug creation.

    R&D and innovation have always been the main lines of sustainable and high-quality development. We continue to promote
    product innovation and upgrade, pay attention to unfulfilled clinical needs, focus on innovative drugs and high-barrier
    complex drug preparations, and continue to enhance innovation and R&D and business layout of our products in the
    segments of psychiatry, oncology and immunity based on
    our traditional segments of assisted reproduction and
    gastroenterology on which we have advantages. In
    2020, Ilaprazole Sodium for Injection (注射用艾
    普拉唑鈉) was shortlisted for the “landmark
    achievements in pharmaceutical science and
    technology of China during the 13th Five-Year
    Plan (十三五中國醫藥科技標誌性成果) ” ;
    clinical trials of Triptorelin Acetate Microspheres
    for Injection (注射用醋酸曲普瑞林微球) (1-month
    sustained release) and Recombinant Humanized Anti-
    IL-6R Monoclonal Antibody for Injection (重組人源化抗
    人IL-6R單克隆抗體注射液) were conducted in significant progress; Aripiprazole Microspheres for Injection (注射用阿立
    哌唑微球) (1-month sustained release), Octreotide Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸奧曲肽微球) (1-month
    sustained release), Recombinant Anti-human IL-17A/F Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Injection (重組抗人IL-17A/F人源化
    單克隆抗體注射液) were approved for clinical trials; Amlodipine Besylate Capsules (苯磺酸氨氯地平膠囊) and Tinidazole
    Tablets (替硝唑片) passed the consistency evaluation. The breakthrough progress made in the research and development of
    these key products has accumulated valuable experience for advancing R&D and applications for registration of other varieties
    and has further strengthened the Company’s position as a first-line innovative pharmaceutical company in the industry.

products, develop innovative business cooperation models in global core regional markets and accelerate the international
industrial layout of the Group.

                                                                         and multiple products obtained top global market
share; we established long-term strategic partnerships with world-renowned companies such as Pfizer, Teva, Baxter and
Zoetis, and were recognized as a high-quality supplier in the international market.

In respect of strategic development, in order to further focus on the major business of innovative pharmaceuticals and
enhance the comprehensive competitiveness of Livzon Diagnostics, a controlling subsidiary of the Company, the general
meeting of the Company approved the spin-off and listing of Livzon Diagnostics on the ChiNext Board of the Shenzhen Stock
Exchange at the end of 2020. In November 2020 and February 2021, Livzon Diagnostics lodged a registration in respect of
the commencement of the tutoring period and submitted the record report of the first interim tutoring with the Guangdong
administration of the CSRC, respectively. In addition, in January 2021, the general meeting of the Company approved the
reorganization and reform of the shareholding structures of the platform companies in the field of biologics, which further
optimized the shareholding structure of the platform companies.

    FUTURE OUTLOOK
    In 2021, We will closely monitor the development of the global pandemic situation to ensure the smooth and orderly progress
    of production and operation activities. Meanwhile, we will use new technologies, new models and new thinking in all fields
    of business operations to digitally and intelligently upgrade operations and management, and accelerate to adapt to the new
    trends in the ever-changing market and economic environment. In early 2021, Henan Province Joincare Biopharmaceutical
    Research Institute Co., Ltd. (河南省健康元生物醫藥研究院有限公司), a joint venture established by a subsidiary of the
    Company and a subsidiary of Joincare, entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with Tencent Quantum Lab (騰訊量
    子實驗室). We will cooperate with Tencent to promote the application of quantum computing + artificial intelligence in
    the field of microbial synthetic biology research and related drug research, so as to make contributions to the development
    and progress of medical research and development technology.

    In the post-pandemic era, we will uphold the mission of “prioritizing the
    quality of life of the patients” with the goal of “becoming a leader
    in the pharmaceutical industry”, take unfulfilled clinical needs as
    the starting point for innovation and R&D, focus on the major
    business of innovative pharmaceuticals and further strengthen
    Livzon’s leading advantages in innovative medicines and
    complex drug preparation platforms with high barriers;
    increase investment in technological innovation and
    management innovation to enhance digitization and
    intelligence level of the Company; attach importance to
    environmental protection, continue to invest funds to improve
    processes and update equipment to achieve the goal of energy
    saving and emission reduction; meanwhile, we will focus more
    on social responsibility, actively participate in charity campaigns,
    maintain our efforts in health-based poverty alleviation and industry-
    based poverty alleviation, and give back to the society with practical actions.

    At the beginning of the new year, President Xi Jinping called on the people of the whole country to learn the spirit of the
    ox in serving the people in the new stage of development by opening up new developments with courage, serving the weak
    with patience and striving to serve people diligently, conscientiously and whole-heartedly like an old ox. Every employee of
    our Company should fully understand the spirit of the President Xi’s speech, always follow the Communist Party, live up to
    the trust of the times, practice the core values of the Company, do a good job in every task and strive to continuously make
    breakthroughs towards deeper innovation and higher quality development.

    On behalf of the Board of the Company, I would like to take this opportunity to express my sincere thanks to all shareholders,
    all staff of the Group and business partners for their long-lasting care and support.

    Zhu Baoguo
    Chairman

    22 March 2021

IMPORTANT NOTICE
The Board, the Supervisory Committee and the Directors, Supervisors and senior management of Livzon Pharmaceutical Group
Inc.* hereby warrant the truthfulness, accuracy and completeness of the contents of this annual report (the “Report”), and
that there are no false representations, misleading statements or material omissions contained in the Report, and severally
and jointly accept responsibility.

The financial statements of the Group for the year ended 31 December 2020 have been prepared in accordance with the
China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises, and have been audited by Grant Thornton (Special General Partnership)
who issued standard unqualified opinions in the audit report.

Mr. Zhu Baoguo (朱保國), the person-in-charge of the Company, Ms. Si Yanxia (司燕霞), the person-in-charge of the
Company’s financial affairs (mainly responsible for accounting work), and Ms. Zhuang Jianying (莊健瑩), the person-in-
charge of the accounting department (the head of the accounting department), declare that they hereby warrant for the
truthfulness, accuracy and completeness of the financial statements contained in the Report.

All Directors of the Company have attended the Board meeting in person for considering the Report.

After consideration and approval by the Board of the Company, the Company ’s profit distribution plan for 2020 is as follows:
it is expected to distribute cash dividend of RMB12.50 (tax inclusive) for every 10 shares to all Shareholders of the Company
on 25 June 2021, based on the Company’s total share capital (excluding the shares of the Company which were repurchased
but not yet cancelled) as at the registration date of shareholding as determined by implementation of the 2020 annual profit
distribution plan. There will be no bonus shares, nor will the capital reserves be capitalized (the “Dividend Distribution Plan
for the Year”). The Dividend Distribution Plan for the Year is still required to be submitted to the 2020 Annual General
Meeting (the “AGM”) of the Company for consideration and approval.

The Company analysed possible risk factors and corresponding strategies in respect of the future development of the Company
in Section IV “Operation Discussion and Analysis (Report of the Board)” of this Report. Investors are advised to review it.

The Report contains forward-looking statements which involve subjective assumptions and judgments of future policies and
economic conditions. These statements are subject to risks, uncertainties and assumptions. The actual outcomes may be
substantially different from these statements. Investors should exercise caution that inappropriate reliance on and usage of
such information may lead to investment risks.

The Report is prepared in both Chinese and English. In case of any discrepancies, the Chinese version shall prevail.

I.     PRINCIPAL BUSINESSES OF THE COMPANY DURING THE YEAR
During the Year, there was no material change in the principal businesses of the Group. The Group was primarily engaged
in the research and development (“R&D”), production and sale of pharmaceutical products, which covered drug preparation
products, active pharmaceutical ingredients ( “APIs”) and intermediates as well as diagnostic reagents and equipment. Major
products include drug preparation products such as Ilaprazole (Ilaprazole Enteric-Coated Tablet and laprazole Sodium for
Injection) (壹麗安(艾普拉唑腸溶片及注射用艾普拉唑納)), a series of Bismuth Potassium Citrate (麗珠得樂(枸櫞酸
鉍鉀)) products, Rabeprazole Sodium Enteric-Coated Capsules (麗倍樂(雷貝拉唑鈉腸溶膠囊)), Weisanlian (Bismuth
Potassium Citrate Tablets/Tinidazole Tablets/Clarithromycin Tablets (維三聯(枸櫞酸鉍鉀片/替硝唑片/克拉霉素片)),
Leuprorelin Acetate Microspheres for Injection (貝依(注射用醋酸亮丙瑞林微球)), Urofollitropin for Injection (麗申寶
(注射用尿促卵泡素)), Menotropins for Injection (樂寶得(注射用尿促性素)), Voriconazole for Injection (麗福康(注射
用伏立康唑)), Fluvoxamine Maleate Tablets (瑞必樂(馬來酸氟伏沙明片)), Perospirone Hydrochloride Tablets (康爾
汀(鹽酸哌羅匹隆片)), Shenqi Fuzheng Injection (參芪扶正注射液), and Anti-viral Granules (抗病毒顆粒); APIs and
intermediates such as Mevastatin (美伐他汀), Acarbose (阿卡波糖), Colistin Sulfate (硫酸粘菌素), Phenylalanine (苯丙氨
酸), Vancomycin Hydrochloride (鹽酸萬古霉素), Daptomycin (達托霉素), Milbemycin Oxime (米爾貝肟) and Ceftriaxone
Sodium (頭孢曲松鈉); and diagnostic reagents such as Diagnostic Kit for IgM/IgG Antibody to Coronavirus (2019-nCoV)
(Colloidal Gold) (新型冠狀病毒(2019-nCoV) IgM/IgG抗體檢測試劑盒(膠體金法)), Diagnostic Kit for IgM Antibody to
Mycoplasma Pneumonia (Colloidal Gold) (肺炎支原體IgM抗體檢測試劑盒(膠體金法)) and Diagnostic Kit for Antibody
to Human Immunodeficiency Virus (ELISA) (人類免疫缺陷病毒抗體檢測試劑盒(酶聯免疫法)).

     III.   ANALYSIS OF CORE COMPETITIVE STRENGTHS
     The Group adheres to the direction of three major strategies of “talent strategy, product strategy and market strategy” and
     upholds the mission of prioritizing the quality of life of its patients with the goal of becoming a leading pharmaceutical
     enterprise within the industry. The Group continuously improved the efficiency of management control and governance
     standards, accelerated the steady progress in research and development and enhanced marketing management continuously,
     thereby achieving stable growth in the performance results. During the Year, the Group’s core competitive strengths were
     further consolidated and enhanced, which were primarily reflected in the following aspects:

     (1)    Strong R&D capabilities and global R&D vision
     The Group has strong research and development (“R&D”) capabilities and global R&D vision in areas such as chemical and
     traditional Chinese drug preparation products, biologics and diagnostic reagents, and has established specialised technology
     platforms for R&D of sustained release microspheres and R&D of biologics with core leading R&D talents. By proactively
     introducing domestic and foreign experts and innovative talents, constantly increasing R&D investments, developing overseas
     strategic alliances, and focusing on areas of assisted reproduction, gastroenterology, psychiatry and neurology and tumor
     immunity, the Group has established a clear and diverse R&D pipeline for products, which further enhanced the R&D
     competitiveness of the Group.

     (2)    Diversified product mix and business layout
     The products of the Group cover a number of pharmaceutical sub-sectors such as drug preparation products, APIs and
     intermediates, diagnostic reagents and equipment, and the Group has established an advantageous market position in a
     number of therapeutic field such as assisted reproduction, gastroenterology, psychiatry, neurology and tumor immunity.
     Currently, the Company further focuses on innovative drug and high-barrier complex drug preparation. Under the policy of
     the consistency evaluation and minimum procurement commitment, the Group enjoys unique advantage in terms of APIs
     and will continue to increase its efforts to integrate API and drug preparation products.

     (3)    Comprehensive marketing system and professional marketing team
     The Group refined its management on marketing activities by improving the establishment of its marketing system, optimizing
     its incentive assessment mechanism and continuously strengthening outlet promotion strategies such as evidence marketing
     and academic marketing. Through optimization of resources allocation, a professional marketing team specialized in, among
     others, drug preparation products (including prescription medicines and non-prescription medicines), diagnostic reagents
     and APIs has been gradually established to form a more comprehensive marketing system. The Group has nearly 10,000
     staff members serving in its marketing management teams for various business segments and providing professional sales
     services to the Group. The Group’s marketing network spreads across the PRC and has expanded into relevant overseas
     countries and regions, covering endusers such as leading medical institutions, chain drugstores, disease control centres,
     health authorities and pharmaceutical enterprises.

     (4)    Mature quality management system
     The Group has established a comprehensive quality management system covering the business processes of production,
     scientific research and sales of its products. During the Year, the Group made continuous efforts to improve its quality
     management, while the effective overall management of production and operating quality of the Group and its sound quality
     management system has ensured the safety and stability of the Group’s products in various fields, further enhancing the
     market competitiveness of the Group’s products.

II.    SUMMARY
Since the beginning of 2020, the outbreak of novel coronavirus pneumonia (“COVID-19”) resulted in an anti-epidemic
atmosphere across the nation. The Group responded immediately and donated materials to assist all people in China to
fight against the epidemic, while preventive controls were put in place within the Group, effective measures were actively
organized and adopted to ensure rapid recovery and orderly operation of various businesses, high quality sustainable
development was further realized.

During the Year, the Group recorded an operating income of RMB10,520.41 million, representing an increase of 12.10% as
compared with RMB9,384.70 million of the Previous Year; a net profit of RMB2,131.33 million, representing an increase of
45.82% as compared with RMB1,461.58 million of the Previous Year; and a net profit attributable to Shareholders of the
Company of RMB1,714.91 million, representing an increase of 31.63% as compared with RMB1,302.88 million of the Previous
Year. Excluding extraordinary gains and losses, the Company’s net profit attributable to its Shareholders generated from
principal businesses in 2020 was RMB1,431.55 million, representing an increase of 20.14% as compared with RMB1,191.54
million of the Previous Year.

In 2020, the progress of major tasks in various business segments of the Group was set out as follows:

(1)    Chemical drug preparation products
During the Year, the Group realized sales revenue of RMB5,402.94 million from chemical drug preparation products,
representing a year-on-year increase of 9.56% and accounting for 51.64% of the Group’s income from principal businesses for
the Year. Among which, the innovative drug Ilaprazole (艾普拉唑) and the high-barrier complex preparation drug Leuprorelin
Sustained Release Microspheres (亮丙瑞林緩釋微球) maintained a high growth, accounting for 54.46% of sales revenue
of chemical drug preparation products, and the contribution of which to the operating income and profit further improved.

The Group regarded R&D innovation as the basis for sustainable development, thus continued to increase investments in
R&D and accelerate innovative upgrading. The Group has been paying attention to unfulfilled clinical demand, with efforts
focused on innovative drugs and high-barrier complex preparation products. With these efforts, the layout of products in the
psychiatry, oncology and immunity areas were strengthened based on our traditional segments of assisted reproduction and
gastroenterology on which we have advantages. During the Year, the medical teams, clinical teams and KA (key accounts)
departments worked in close collaboration and achieved notable acceleration in the R&D progress of key products under
research, a number of important progressive developments were also achieved in the pipelines under research:

Complex preparations: The project of Triptorelin Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸曲普瑞林微球)
(1-month sustained release) completed patient enrollment for phase III clinical trial; the project of Aripiprazole Microspheres
for Injection (注射用阿立呱唑微球)(one-month sustained release) received notice for clinical trial and is currently under
the stage of phase I clinical trial; the project of Octreotide Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸奧曲肽微球)
(1-month sustained release) received notice for clinical trial and has initiated BE testing; while the project of Leuprorelin
Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸亮丙瑞林微球) (3-month sustained release) began phase I clinical trial
and completed genetic filing for phase III clinical trial;

II.    SUMMARY (continued)
(1)    Chemical drug preparation products (continued)
In order to strengthen the whole life cycle management of drug and the risk management of drug safety, the Group has
formulated relevant management systems and management measures for drug tracing, permit-holders for the sale of drugs
and random inspection. Contingency plan for responsive plans in material drug safety emergency events, random inspection
process and work process of production on-site inspection for drug registration were formulated and announced to guide
each production enterprise to realize daily standardized management and handle contingent and emergency events. To
prevent loopholes in quality management, regional and systematic risks, the quality management head department of the
Company formulated inspection rules under the six major GMP systems, pursuant to which the quality risks of the relevant
key products were screened thoroughly and systematically, further enhancing the sound operation of the quality management
system of the Group.

As at the end of 2020, the quality management head department of the Company had conducted a total of 42 audits,
including 11 cross-examinations, 6 specific/random inspections for production of drug preparations, 8 simulated inspections for
R&D projects and 6 specific inspections for R&D projects. In 2020, the Company was newly added as the applicant for market
launch of some new products under research. Meanwhile, the MAH quality department was established to be responsible for
the building and operation of the MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder) quality system and clearance approval management
for market launch of future products.

(2)    Biologics
In 2020, the Group supplemented the structure and team members and optimized allocation of resources around the three
major aspects of “project, team and platform” in the field of biologics. R&D of biologics are conducted in the areas of
oncology, immune disease and assisted reproduction. Firstly, the focus was on new molecules, new targets and differentiated
molecular design and optimizing the new drug R&D and evaluation technology platform for biologics continuously. Secondly,
the cell therapy technology R&D platform was optimized to achieve breakthrough in solid tumor and common cell therapeutic
areas.

During the Year, our platform for biologics focused on core R&D projects, enhanced the process management for projects
and emphasized on both quality and timeliness of R&D, while closer cooperation was fostered between the Group’s clinical
operation department and medical science department, R&D efficiency was enhanced: manufacturing on-site inspection and
registration examination for Recombinant Human Chorionic Gonadotropin for Injection (注射用重組人絨促性素) were
completed, while overseas registration began simultaneously; patient enrollment for phase III clinical trial of Recombinant
Humanized Anti-IL-6R Monoclonal Antibody for Injection (重組人源化抗人IL-6R單克隆抗體注射液) was completed;
phase Ib/II clinical trial for registration of Recombinant Humanized Anti-PD-1 Monoclonal Antibody for Injection (注射用重
組人源化抗PD-1單克隆抗體) for thymic cancer completed two-thirds of patient enrollment; approvals for clinical trials of
Recombinant Anti-human IL-17A/F Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Injection (重組抗人IL-17A/F人源化單克隆抗體注
射液) and Recombinant Tumor Enzyme Specific Interferon αα-2b Fc Fusion for Injection (注射用重組腫瘤酶特異性干擾
素αα-2b Fc融合蛋白) were obtained and phase I clinical trials had begun.

In terms of organization structure, LivzonBio gradually improved its organization structure and team building to match with
the structural reorganization and reforms of the Group in the area of biologic.

     II.    SUMMARY (continued)
     (3)    APIs and intermediates
     In 2020, the Company’s API business department to adhered to the guiding philosophy of “safeguarding safety and
     environmental protection, ensuring quality, reducing costs and grabbing the market”, made great and practical efforts
     to continue to strengthen its work in EHS, quality, R&D, production and sales. During the Year, the Group realized sales
     revenue of RMB2,440.26 million from APIs and intermediates products, representing a year-on-year increase of 3.84%, and
     accounting for 23.32% of the Group’s income from principal businesses for the Year. The percentage of sales revenue and
     profit of specialty APIs continued to increase, the gross profit margin increased by 1.20 percentage points when compared
     with the Previous Year with increasing growth in profitability.

     Although the market was affected by COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, with the continuous increase in overseas registration
     of key products, the competitiveness and market share of API products in overseas market further increased. In particular,
     high-end antibiotic products with Vancomycin Hydrochloride (鹽酸萬古霉素) as the core had seen further growth in the
     European and American markets; we continued to maintain strategic partnerships with and obtained orders from major
     customers in respect of intermediate products; we established strategic partnerships with major animal healthcare companies
     in respect of high-end pet products.

     During the Year, our R&D capabilities in the field of APIs continued to improve: in respect of fermentation R&D, we completed
     the verification and batch production stage for industrialization of Dalbavancin (達巴萬星), Oritavancin (奧利萬星) and
     Telavancin (特拉萬星) products; we completed the technology upgrades and production of old products, and carried out
     the modification and fermentation optimization of multiple strains; in respect of synthesis R&D, we completed the Route C
     development, process optimization and scale-up batch production of Pimofanserin Tartrate (酒石酸匹莫范色林) crystal; we
     completed the independent R&D and industrialization of two Lana (拉那) products; in respect of the R&D of animal healthcare
     products, we completed the R&D of three product specifications and successfully achieved industrialization verification and
     batch production. In addition, in order to integrate and strengthen external R&D human resources and R&D capabilities and
     strengthen the innovative R&D of biomedical intermediates and high-end specialty APIs, Xinbeijiang Pharmaceutical and
     Jiaozuo Joincare jointly invested and established a company for R&D of APIs during the Year.

During the Year, we continued to increase investment in safety and environmental protection. At the same time, by

Vancomycin Hydrochloride micropowder (鹽酸萬古霉素微粉), Vancomycin Hydrochloride freeze-dried powder (鹽酸萬古
霉素凍乾粉), Colistin Methane Sulfonate (粘菌素甲烷磺酸鈉), Milbemycin Oxime (米爾貝肟), Moxidectin (莫西克汀)
and Hydrochloride Lincomycin (鹽酸林可霉素); Tobramycin Sulfate (硫酸妥布黴素) was approved for registration by the
US FDA; Moxictin (莫昔克丁) was approved for registration in Australia; and Pentostatin (噴司他汀) was approved for
registration in Japan. As at 31 December 2020, the Group had completed 84 registration projects for a total of 28 products
in 49 countries/regions.

As at 31 December 2020, the Group’s APIs had passed 16 on-site inspections of international certification, obtained 48
certificates for international certification during the validity period (of which 4 varieties have passed FDA on-site inspections
and 12 varieties have obtained CEP certificates) and 2 qualification certificates.

(4)     Diagnostic reagents and equipment
During the Year, the Group’s diagnostic reagents and equipment realized sales revenue of RMB1,382.77 million, representing
a year-on-year increase of 83.29%, and accounting for 13.22% of the Group’s income from principal businesses for the Year.

In 2020, under the impact of the pandemic, the original in vitro diagnosis products for respiratory diseases and epidemics
were affected due to the falling volume of outpatient and inpatient cases in end-user medical institutions, but sales revenue
from self-produced reagent products for HIV, HCV, TP and other contagious diseases and other areas remained stable. In
mid-March 2020, the Diagnostic Kit for IgM/IgG Antibody to Coronavirus (2019-nCoV) (Colloidal Gold) (新型冠狀病毒(2019-
nCoV) IgM/IgG抗體檢測試劑盒(膠體金法)) of Livzon Diagnostics was approved for launch in domestic market, and received
registration approvals consecutively from 15 countries and regions. During the first half of 2020, with overseas outbreak of
COVID-19 on a large scale, the demand for COVID-19 diagnostic products in export markets increased significantly, giving an
important support to the growth of the Group’s overall performance. By the end of 2020, two types of COVID-19 diagnostic
products also received the European Union CE certification: Diagnostic Kit for Antigens of SARS-CoV-2 (Latex method) (新
冠抗原檢測試劑盒(乳膠法)) of Livzon Diagnostics and Diagnostic Kit for Antigens of SARS-CoV-2 (Immunofluorescence
method)(新冠抗原檢測試劑盒(免疫螢光法)) of Livzon Diagnostics have increased the types of COVID-19 diagnostic
reagents available, which expanded the supply of diagnostics kits to novel coronavirus and further satisfy the global needs
of preventive control over the spread of pandemic.

With the export of COVID-19 diagnostic reagents, Livzon Diagnostics has established an overseas sales division which lay
a foundation for the expansion of other diagnostic products into overseas markets in the future. As at 31 December 2020,
a total of 16 products of Livzon Diagnostics obtained CE certification from European Union; 8 technology platforms have
passed TUV on-site inspections and 1 quality certification was obtained.

     Pediatric Lung-heat Cough Granules (小兒肺熱咳喘顆粒) entered into the relevant guidebook for diagnostic treatment of
     COVID-19. During the pandemic, various online academic marketing activities were organized, new media were fully utilized
     for branding communication and interactions, product coverage at terminals such as chain pharmacy stores continued to
     expand, sales of Anti-viral Granules (抗病毒顆粒) achieved continuous growth.

II.    SUMMARY (continued)
(6)    Functions and Strategies
At the beginning of 2020 after the outbreak of the pandemic, the Company responded rapidly and successively donated
cash and medicines in value of over RMB16.00 million to Red Cross Society of Zhuhai, Wuhan and other places to fight the
pandemic and fulfilled our corporate social responsibilities.

During the Year, the Group revamped the corporate cultural values to pursue the goal of “becoming a leader in the
pharmaceutical industry”, achieve the mission of “prioritizing the quality of life of the patients” and follow the basic
development theme of “back to square one and start all over again”, by focusing on pharmaceuticals as core business,
enhancing the strengths of innovative drugs and complex preparations platform with high barriers continuously, increasing
investments in technological and management innovations, improving corporate capabilities for sustainable development
comprehensively through digital and intelligent new technologies and new models, performing social responsibilities actively
and striving to realize high quality development for the Company. The key tasks in the functional areas were as follows:
firstly, further optimized the organizational structure and institutional settings of the Group and some units to improve
performance in terms of efficiency; secondly, enhanced attraction and reserve of middle and high level talents from around
the world in the fields of biologics, chemical medicine, pet preparations, etc., while strengthening associations with higher
education institutions such as Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大學), China Medical University (中國醫科大學)
and China Academy of Sciences (中國科學院) and establishing cooperative relationship between universities and enterprises;
thirdly, reshaped our corporate culture system and established a set of highly united core values; fourthly, improved capital
management efficiency and return on capital, strengthened the tax planning function, streamlined the foreign exchange
risk management system and optimized the building of financial informatization; and fifthly, the environmental, social and
governance committee was established under the Board of the Group to assist the Board in decision-making the relevant
matters of environmental, social and corporate governance issues to facilitate the continuous enhancement of the Group’s
environmental, social and governance level.

During the Year, the Company repurchased a total of 6,093,808 A Shares through centralized bidding transactions for a
total amount of approximately RMB250 million (including transaction costs). Afterwards, the Company also initiated the H
Share repurchase plan, and convened the Board meeting and the general meeting in November 2020 and December 2020,
respectively, to consider and approve the general mandate to repurchase the H Shares of the Company. As at the date of
disclosure of this Report, the Company has repurchased 6,628,600 H Shares.

     During the Year, the sales income and year-on-year change of key drug preparation products are as follows: the sales income
     generated by key gonadotropic hormones products Leuprorelin Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸亮丙瑞林
     微球) amounted to RMB1,176.32 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 27.01%, and the sales income generated
     by Urofollitropin for Injection (注射用尿促卵泡素) amounted to RMB512.76 million, representing a year-on-year decrease
     of 18.15%. The sales income generated by key gastroenterological product Ilaprazole series (艾普拉唑系列) amounted
     to RMB1,765.91 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 81.20%.In particular, the sales income generated by
     Ilaprazole Enteric-Coated Tablet (艾普拉唑腸溶片) amounted to RMB945.10 million, representing a year-on-year increase
     of 8.84%; the sales income generated by Ilaprazole Sodium for Injection (注射用艾普拉唑鈉) amounted to RMB820.81
     million, representing a year-on-year increase of 672.61%; the sales income generated by Rabeprazole Sodium Enteric-coated
     Capsules (雷貝拉唑鈉腸溶膠囊) amounted to RMB198.24 million, representing a year-on-year decrease of 19.57%; the
     sales income generated by the Bismuth Potassium Citrate series (得樂系列) amounted to RMB222.41 million, representing
     a year-on-year increase of 7.16%; the sales income generated by Livzon Weisanlian (麗珠維三聯) amounted to RMB241.96
     million, representing a year-on-year decrease of 4.24%. The sales income generated by key psychiatric products, Fluvoxamine
     Maleate Tablets (馬來酸氟伏沙明片) and Perospirone Hydrochloride Tablets (鹽酸哌羅匹隆片), amounted to RMB171.47
     million and RMB107.19 million respectively, representing a year-on-year increase of 33.00% and 101.78% respectively. The
     sales income generated by key antimicrobial product Voriconazole for Injection (注射用伏立康唑) amounted to RMB204.32
     million, representing a year-on-year decrease of 16.85%. The sales income generated by traditional Chinese drug preparation
     product Shenqi Fuzheng Injection (參芪扶正注射液) amounted to RMB606.04 million, representing a year-on-year decrease
     of 25.81%. The sales income generated by Anti-viral Granules (抗病毒顆粒) amounted to RMB462.15 million, representing
     a year-on-year increase of 52.02%.

     The income and year-on-year change of key APIs and intermediates are as follows: the sales income generated by
     Phenylalanine (苯丙氨酸) amounted to RMB331.86 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 32.42%; the sales income
     generated by Acarbose (阿卡波糖) amounted to RMB205.59 million, representing a year-on-year decrease of 18.69%; the
     sales income generated by Vancomycin Hydrochloride (鹽酸萬古霉素) amounted to RMB143.69 million, representing a
     year-on-year increase of 5.97%; the sales income generated by Daptomycin (達托霉素) amounted to RMB97.60 million,
     representing a year-on-year increase of 34.52%; the sales income generated by Lincomycin (林可霉素) amounted to
     RMB82.69 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 32.27%; the sales income generated by Milbemycin Oxime (米
     爾貝肟) amounted to RMB81.07 million, representing a year-on-year decrease of 39.11%; and the sales income generated
     by Mevastatin (美伐他汀) amounted to RMB81.92 million, representing a year-on-year decrease of 43.82%.

     The growth of the Group’s income of principal businesses was primarily due to the Company’s ongoing dedication to the
     marketing system reforms and implementation of refined management, with continuous enhancement of sales income from
     key drug preparation products as a percentage to the total operating income. For example, there was a rapid substantial
     increase in the sales of Ilaprazole Sodium for Injection (注射用艾普拉唑鈉), a key product of our chemical drug preparation,
     as compared with that during the Previous Year together with a continuous greater growth in the sales of Leuprorelin
     Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸亮丙瑞林微球), Perospirone Hydrochloride Tablets (鹽酸哌羅匹隆片)
     and Fluvoxamine Maleate Tablets (馬來酸氟伏沙明片) compared with those during the Previous Year, and owing to the
     pandemic, a significant growth in the sale of Anti-viral Granules (抗病毒顆粒), a key product of our Traditional Chinese
     drug preparation, as compared with that of the Previous Year, and additional sales of diagnostic kits for antibodies to novel
     coronavirus, which contributed to a significant support to the stable growth of the overall performance of the Company.

     During the Year, the Group’s total operating costs of principal businesses amounted to RMB3,632.21 million, representing
     an increase of RMB288.27 million or 8.62% as compared with RMB3,343.94 million of the Previous Year, which was mainly
     due to increase in costs for principal businesses in line with our increase in sales.

     (1)     Chemical drug preparation products
     Complex preparations: There were a total of 6 projects under research, including 1 project in phase III clinical trial,
     2 projects in phase I clinical trial, 1 project initiated BE testing, and 1 project applied for clinical trial; among which, the
     project of Triptorelin Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用醋酸曲普瑞林微球) (1-month sustained release) was in
     phase III clinical trial with the data being collated; the project of Aripiprazole Microspheres for Injection (注射用阿立呱唑
     微球) (1-month sustained release) was in the process of phase I clinical trial; the project of Leuprorelin Acetate Microspheres
     for Injection (注射用醋酸亮丙瑞林微球) (3-month sustained release) conducted phase I clinical trial as scheduled and
     completed heredity filing for phase III clinical trial; the project of Octreotide Acetate Microspheres for Injection (注射用
     醋酸奧曲肽微球) (1-month sustained release) initiated BE testing; the project of Triptorelin Pamoate Microspheres for
     Injection (注射用雙羥萘酸曲普瑞林微球) (3-month sustained release) had applied for clinical trial; and the project of
     Goserelin Acetate Sustained-release Implant (醋酸戈舍瑞林緩釋植入劑) (1-month sustained release) was in the stage of
     pharmaceutical research technique optimizing stage.

     Conventional preparations: There were a total of 26 projects under research, of which 2 projects obtained approvals,
     3 projects had applied for production, 5 projects started clinical trial/BE research, and 1 project had completed technical
     process verification. Among which, Dantrolene Sodium for Injection (注射用丹曲林鈉) and Carbohydrate and Electrolyte
     Injection (混合糖電解質注射液) obtained approval for market launch; Cetrorelix Acetate for Injection (注射用醋酸西
     曲瑞克) (in China and United States) and Voriconazole for Injection (注射用伏立康唑) (0.2g) had submitted application
     for market launch; Paclitaxel Polymeric Micelles for Injection (注射用紫杉醇聚合物膠束) was under phase I clinical trial;
     Lurasidone Hydrochloride Tablets (鹽酸魯拉西酮片) had prepared for official BE filing; Blonanserin Tablets (布南色林片)
     and new indications of Ilaprazole Sodium for Injection (注射用艾普拉唑鈉) received notices for clinical trials.

     Consistency evaluation: There were a total of 21 projects under research, of which 2 projects obtained approvals, 6
     projects had applied for production, 2 projects started BE research, and 1 project completed technical process verification.
     Tinidazole Tablets (替硝唑片) and Amlodipine Besylate Capsules (苯磺酸氨氯地平膠囊) obtained consistency evaluation
     approvals. Isosorbide Bononitrate Tablets (單硝酸異山梨酯片), Cefodizime Sodium for Injection (注射用頭孢地嗪鈉),
     Omeprazole Sodium for Injection (注射用奧美拉唑鈉), Alanyl Glutamine Injection (丙氨醯穀氨醯胺注射液), Fluvoxamine
     Maleate Tablets (馬來酸氟伏沙明片) and Clarithromycin Tablets (克拉霉素片) were under evaluation.

     (2)     Biologics
     There were a total of 9 projects under research, of which 1 project has applied for production, 1 project was in phase III
     clinical trial, 1 project was in phase Ib/II clinical trial, 2 projects were in phase I clinical trials, 2 projects were in the stage
     of IND application and 2 projects were in the pre-clinical R&D stage.

     Among these projects, the project of Recombinant Human Chorionic Gonadotropin for Injection (注射用重組人絨促性素)

     Toxin Drug (重組人源化單克隆抗體偶聯毒素藥物) were in the stage of pre-clinical research.

     17.     Foreign exchange risks
     Details of foreign exchange risks of the Group are set out in “Note VIII. Risk management of financial instruments” to the
     financial statements prepared in accordance with the China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises in the Report. As
     RMB is the major denominated currency of the Company, in case of sales, purchases and investment/financing businesses
     which are not settled in RMB, corresponding foreign exchange risk exposure is incurred. With “prevention and control of risk
     and locking in profit” as its management goal, the Company has established the “Management System for Foreign Exchange
     Risk” that requires a certain hedging ratio, and uses foreign exchange financial derivatives to monitor and control the foreign
     exchange risk, so as to minimize the impact arising from fluctuations of exchange rates on the business of the Company.

of RMB70,091,000 to subscribe for an additional registered capital of Atom Bioscience of RMB2,250,639, accounting for
7.8215% of the registered capital of Atom Bioscience upon completion of the capital contribution. The board of directors
of Atom Bioscience comprises of seven directors, among which one is appointed by Livzon Equity Investment Company.

Atom Bioscience is mainly engaged in the research and development of human medicine, veterinary medicine, pesticide,
health products and chemical products, technology transfer, technical consultancy and cooperation projects of products.

Upon completion of the capital contribution, the Company will commence cooperation with Atom Bioscience pursuant to the
relevant requirements under the Capital Contribution Agreement with respect to the related products including the innovative
drugs for treatment of metabolic diseases and tumours. The investment is in line with the strategic layout of the medium
and long-term research and development pipelines of the Company.

     Sichuan Chengdu Pengzhou Municipal People’s Government (四川省成都市彭州市人民政府). Pursuant to the Investment
     Agreement, the Company will inject capital of RMB646 million for investment in construction of the overall relocation

Risk analysis of derivatives position held during the Reporting Period and        To effectively manage the uncertainty of exchange rate fluctuations on assets denominated in foreign currency of the Company, foreign exchange forward contracts and other financial derivatives are
   explanation of control measures (including but not limited to market risk,     employed to lock relevant exchange rates for the purpose of hedging. The Company has formulated the “Foreign Exchange Risk Management Measures” in relation to the operation and control of foreign
   liquidity risk, credit risk, operational risk, legal risk, etc.)               exchange derivatives: 1. Market risk: the uncertainty of exchange rate fluctuations in the foreign exchange market has led to higher market risk in foreign exchange forward business. Control measures:
                                                                                  The Company’s foreign exchange forward business is entered into for hedging exchange rate risk associated with assets denominated in US dollar and lock the future exchange settlement price of such
                                                                                  assets. It is designed to be used as a hedging instrument. Such foreign exchange derivatives shall not be used for speculative trading. The principle of prudence and conservation shall be observed so
                                                                                  as to effectively prevent market risk. 2. Operational risk: operational risk arises from imperfect internal process, improper operation, system failure and other factors. Control measures: The Company
                                                                                  has formulated the corresponding management measures, clearly defined the responsibilities of all parties, improved the review and approval process and established supervisory mechanism, so as to
                                                                                  effectively reduce operational risk. 3. Legal risk: The Company’s foreign exchange forward business is subject to applicable laws and regulations, and shall clearly stipulate the relationship of rights and
                                                                                  obligations with financial institutions. Control measures: In addition to strengthening the knowledge of laws and regulations and market rules in the Company’s responsible department, the Company’s
                                                                                  legal department shall also strictly review various business contracts, agreements and other documents, clarify rights and obligations, and strengthen compliance inspection, so as to ensure that the
                                                                                  Company’s investment and operation in derivatives have met the requirements of applicable laws and regulations as well as the Company’s internal systems.
                                                                                  In order to manage the uncertainty risk caused by price fluctuations of bulk commodities on the purchase cost of raw materials of the Company, financial derivatives such as commodity futures contracts
                                                                                  are employed to hedge raw materials. The Company has formulated the “Measures for the Management of Commodity Futures Hedging Business” to standardize the management and risk control of
                                                                                  commodity futures derivatives: 1. Market risk: the uncertainty of price changes of bulk commodities has led to greater market risk in futures business. Control measures: The Company’s futures hedging
                                                                                  business shall not carry out speculative trading, the operation principle of prudence and conservation shall be observed, the number of hedging transactions shall be strictly limited, such that it does not
                                                                                  exceed the actual number of spot transactions, and the futures position shall not exceed the spot volume for hedging purpose. 2. Operational risk: operational risk arises from imperfect internal process,
                                                                                  improper operation, system failure and other factors. Control measures: The Company has formulated the corresponding management system, clearly defined the division of responsibilities and approval
                                                                                  process, and established an improved supervisory mechanism, so as to effectively reduce operational risk through risk control of business process, decision-making process and transaction process. 3.
                                                                                  Legal risk: The Company’s commodity futures hedging business is subject to applicable laws and regulations, and shall clearly stipulate the relationship of rights and obligations with financial institutions.
                                                                                  Control measures: In addition to strengthening the knowledge of laws and regulations and market rules in the Company’s responsible department, the Company’s legal department shall also strictly
                                                                                  review various business contracts, agreements and other documents, clarify rights and obligations, and strengthen compliance inspection, so as to ensure that the Company’s investment and operation in
                                                                                  derivatives have met the requirements of applicable laws and regulations as well as the Company’s internal systems.

     Explanation on overall use of proceeds
     With the “Approval in relation to the Non-public Issuance of Shares by Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc.” (Zheng Jian Xu
     Ke [2016] No. 1524) issued by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the Company made a non-public issuance of
     29,098,203 ordinary shares (A Shares) denominated in RMB with a nominal value of RMB1 per share at an issue price of
     RMB50.10 per share, the total amount of proceeds raised amounted to RMB1,457.82 million, and after deduction of issuance
     expenses of RMB37.5196 million, the amount of RMB1,420.3004 million was transferred into the account of the Company
     on 2 September 2016.

     The proceeds were mainly used for the “Project for indepth development and industrialization upgrade of innovative Ilaprazole
     series (艾普拉唑系列創新產品深度開發及產業化升級項目)”, the “Construction project for research & development
     platform for prolonged-action microsphere technologies (長效微球技術研發平台建設項目)”, the “Relocation and
     expansion project of Livzon Group Xinbeijiang Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Inc. (first phase) (麗珠集團新北江製藥股
     份有限公司搬遷擴建項目(一期))”, the “Technological transformation project of bag infusion workshop for Livzon Group
     Limin Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Factory (麗珠集團利民製藥廠袋裝輸液車間技改項目)” as well as for replenishment
     of working capital and repayment of bank loans, which were consistent with the uses passed by the resolutions of the Board
     of the Company. As at 31 December 2020, unused proceeds were still deposited in the special account for raised funds or
     under cash management, and which will continue to be used in projects invested with proceeds.

XV. PROSPECTS FOR FUTURE DEVELOPMENT
In the post-pandemic era, the Group will continue adhering to the vision of “becoming a leader in the pharmaceutical
industry” and the mission of making “prioritizing the quality of life of the patients”, aiming at satisfying unfulfilled clinical
needs as our objective for innovation, research and development, focusing on pharmaceuticals as our core business, further
enhancing our strengths in innovative drug and complex preparation platforms with high barriers, increasing investment in
technological and management innovations, enhancing the corporate digital and information technology levels and performing
social responsibilities actively and persistently to realize high quality corporate development.

In 2021, the Group will continue to closely monitor the global situation of the pandemic, adopt various types of measures
to alleviate the possible adverse effects of the pandemic on corporate operations, ensure steady and orderly production and
operating activities, making persistent attempts on new technologies and new models, and speeding up the pace in adapting
to the changing new trends of the market and economic environment. Key efforts will be focused on the following areas:

(1)     Chemical drug preparation products
In respect of innovative R&D, the Group will continue to strengthen our target management and appraisal mechanism and
make progress of our projects under research in stages and according to plans. In order to keep upgrading the chemical and
clinical research quality management system, the quality management head office of the Company will formulate annual
audit plans and complete key project audits based on the progress of our clinical trial projects. At the same time, the
Group will integrate our resources and fully utilize the edges of our own APIs advantages to couple with the R&D of drug
preparation products with the aim of forming an integrated industrial chain. In addition to continue strengthening our own
R&D, the Group will optimize R&D platforms through integration of our resources, strengthen external cooperation, and
optimize our product pipelines through various forms including external introduction and joint development. Internal and
external training and talent recruitment will be strengthened to improve our overall R&D capability and build-up a stronger
and more efficient R&D team.

In 2021, our key work deployments in marketing are as follows: firstly, strengthen the building of our marketing team, focus
on our terminal resources, emphasize appraisal of KA, and Class III and key Class II hospitals, formulate appraisal scheme
based on meeting goals, combine Ilaprazole (艾普拉唑), the core product of the Company, with other key drugs and further
promote marketing of psychiatric products; secondly, establish an online operation center targeting on brand-building and
exploration and development of a digitalized sales model; thirdly, keep abreast of the national medical reform policies and
local enforced measures, such as minimum procurement commitment and DRGs; and fourthly, accelerate the establishment
of a talent system for international business of preparations to drive forward the overseas registration and certification for
drug products, broaden sales varieties and increase overseas marketing efforts.

In respect of production, we always consider quality and safety to be our top priorities, systematically implementing risk control
of quality and safety. The quality management head department of the Company will keep taking regulatory compliance
in operation as our core value by establishing systems and optimizing procedures, and will continue to strictly control the
risk of product quality and emphasize on control of sources of raw and auxiliary materials and production process to fulfil
requirement of precise and efficient audits, and further eliminate the risk of production quality in accordance with the
inspection rules under the six systems of GMP. Material quality and safety incidents shall be avoided. The GSP management
will be continuously strengthened to empower daily supervision and management, so as to ensure the effective operation
of our drug business quality management system. Through refined management, we can rigorously maintain our edges in
safety and environmental protection, quality and cost, and consolidate the competitiveness of our products.




                                                                           Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc. Annual Report 2020
72   SECTION IV. OPERATION DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS
     (REPORT OF THE BOARD)


     XV. PROSPECTS FOR FUTURE DEVELOPMENT (Continued)
     (2)    Biologics
     In 2021, the key task and mission in the field of biologics will still be making rapid progress in R&D projects, and as more
     projects are entering the stage of filing for production, the enhancement of the company’s quality system and the process
     of commercialization of products will be accelerated.

     The key tasks and missions of R&D projects comprise the following aspects: firstly, driving for advancement in clinical trials
     for the core projects such as Recombinant Anti-human IL-17A/F Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Injection (重組抗人IL-17A/
     F人源化單克隆抗體注射液); secondly, completion of BLA filing for the product varieties including Recombinant Humanized
     Anti-IL-6R Monoclonal Antibody for Injection (重組人源化抗人IL-6R單克隆抗體注射液); thirdly, accelerating the research
     progress in pre-clinical trial projects such as Recombinant Human Follitropin Alfa for Injection (重組人促卵泡激素注射液)
     and Recombinant Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Conjugate Toxin Drug (重組人源化單克隆抗體偶聯毒素藥物). In
     addition, the company will also continue to strengthen the R&D layout for targeted biological drugs and cell therapy, keep
     on expanding the R&D pipeline, develop new products through introduction or self- R&D, commence external cooperation
     actively, select and introduce more global innovative pharmaceutical projects by using resources from different sources.
     Patent application and protection work will be commenced to strengthen the patent layout of global innovative projects.

     In terms of production quality, the establishment of quality system will be reinforced and commercialization capabilities will
     be enhanced. In 2021, the company will focus on various preparation work for manufacturing on-site inspection of drug
     registration of Recombinant Humanized Anti-IL-6R Monoclonal Antibody for Injection (重組人源化抗人IL-6R單克隆抗
     體注射液), welcome the manufacturing on-site inspection and prepare the market layout in advance for launching this
     product in the market.

     In terms of market layout for products, preparation for market launch and post-launch marketing promotions of Recombinant
     Human Chorionic Gonadotropin for Injection (注射用重組人絨促性素) will be made. Meanwhile, overseas registration for
     such product will be pursued for expansion into overseas markets. By leveraging the resources of the business and overseas
     marketing teams of the Group, technological transfer and authorization of other projects under research will be developed
     actively to create economic benefits for LivzonBio and enhance its corporate image and market competitiveness.

     (3)    APIs and intermediates

     XVI. RISKS AND RESPONSE MEASURES
     1.     Risk of changes in industrial policies
     The pharmaceutical manufacturing industry is significantly affected by changes in industrial policies. As China has been
     deepening reforms of the pharmaceutical and health systems, the relevant systems of policies and regulations are further
     amended and improved, the measures such as the enforcement and adjustment of the medical insurance catalogue, the
     continuous implementation of a new round of minimum procurement commitment and the launch of DRGs and DIP may have
     deep and lasting impact on the future development of the pharmaceutical industry, and promulgation of various policies may
     have different levels of impact on the Group’s research and development, production and sales. In late December 2020, the
     National Healthcare Security Administration and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security published the 2020
     Catalogue of Drugs for National Basic Medical Insurance, Work Injury Insurance and Maternity Insurance (the “National
     Medical Insurance Catalogue (2020)”). Through the adjustments, a total of 2,800 pharmaceutical products were included
     in the National Medical Insurance Catalogue (2020), including 1,426 western drugs, 1,374 Chinese patent drugs, and 892
     kinds of traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces to which no adjustment was made.

     Response measures: The Group did not participate in the admission and negotiation work of the medical insurance catalogue
     in respect of product in process for the year 2020. Currently, a total of 187 products of the Group are included in the
     National Medical Insurance Catalogue (2020), with 95 drugs in the class A list and 92 drugs in the class B list. Among the
     adjustments to the Catalogue for the year 2019, Ilaprazole Enteric-Coated Tablet (艾普拉唑腸溶片) was added into the
     coverage of national medical insurance reimbursement for Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (反流性食管炎), Perospirone
     Hydrochloride Tablets (鹽酸哌羅匹隆片) entered the regular catalogue of national medical insurance, and Ilaprazole Sodium
     for Injection (注射用艾普拉唑鈉) entered the negotiation catalogue of national medical insurance. Inclusion of these
     products in the National Medical Insurance Catalogue helped to enhance their promotion and sales and enabled these three
     products to achieve high growth rates, for example, the growth rate of income from sales of Ilaprazole Sodium for Injection
     (注射用艾普拉唑鈉) was 672.61% and the growth rate of income from sales of Perospirone Hydrochloride Tablets (鹽酸
     哌羅匹隆片) was 101.78%, and would continue to have a positive impact on the future operating results of the Company.
     Furthermore, the Company will respond actively to changes in the industry, pay close attention and conduct studies on the
     relevant policies of the industry, and strengthen our innovative and R&D capabilities.

     2.     Risk of decline in the prices of products
     After pharmaceutical products are approved and launched in the market, in addition to market competition, they are also
     affected by many factors in various aspects, including medical insurance, tenders, in particular industry policy of minimum
     procurement commitment, which makes pharmaceutical enterprises face pressure of price decline. (i) Minimum procurement
     commitment refers to the process of tender or price negotiation in centralized purchase of drugs where the exact quantity
     to be purchased shall be specified, so that bidding price for specific amounts of drugs may be provided by enterprises. In
     the first half of 2020, the second round of minimum procurement commitment was formally implemented, a total of 33
     medical products are involved, covering the treatment areas of, among others, diabetes, hypertension and anti-tumor, and
     a total of 122 enterprises have participated. The average price reduction rate in this centralized procurement reached 53%,
     with maximum reduction rate of up to 93%. In August 2020, the selection results of the third round of centralized drug
     procurement organized by the State were published. According to statistics, the centralized drug procurement included
     55 medical products, 125 enterprises, 191 drug regulations, with an average price reduction of 53%, and the maximum
     price reduction rate was over 95%. With continuous implementation of the minimum procurement commitment policy, a
     normalized and standardized system of minimum procurement commitment will be established subsequently, more products
     will be included in the scope of centralized minimum procurement commitment, it is expected that drug prices may continue
     to present a downward trend within a certain period of time. (ii) Price reduction was also seen in the national insurance
     negotiations. Among the 162 drugs that entered into negotiations in 2020, 119 drugs were successfully negotiated with a
     success rate of 73.46%. The price of drugs successfully negotiated was reduced by 50.64% on average.




     Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc. Annual Report 2020
SECTION IV. OPERATION DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS                                                                                              75
(REPORT OF THE BOARD)


XVI. RISKS AND RESPONSE MEASURES (Continued)
2.      Risk of decline in the prices of products (Continued)
Response measures: (i) For minimum procurement commitment, since most of the potential enterprises are willing to lower
their prices in exchange for more quantity, therefore the price of drugs of the winning bidders may decrease significantly.
However, since a certain procurement volume shall be specified to facilitate arrangements for production and sales, the unit
production cost of drugs will be lowered through economies of scale, and less cross-regional marketing promotions will
save selling expenses for enterprises. Therefore, if larger sales volume is awarded, the impact of lower price may be offset,
which will have significant implications on strengthening the market position of the enterprise in the industry. Hospital is
one of the major customers of the Company, the Company will pay close attention to the developments of the policy of
minimum procurement commitment. As at the End of the Reporting Period, there are 7 products being produced by the
Company including Cetirizine Hydrochloride Tablets (鹽酸西替利嗪片) and Clarithromycin Tablets (克拉霉素片) on the
list of minimum procurement commitment, which generated an aggregate sales income of RMB1.5546 million, representing
1.48% of the operating income of the Company during the Period. Since the abovementioned products of the Company have
not yet passed the consistency evaluation and did not participate in the bidding for minimum procurement commitment, and
the sales revenue from the aforesaid products represented a relatively low percentage in the overall operating income of the
Group, therefore they did not have a material impact on the production and operation and current results of the Company.
(ii) For adjustments made to the medical insurance catalogue, as Ilaprazole Sodium for Injection (注射用艾普拉唑鈉), the
patented new drug developed by our Company, is admitted to the 2019 National Medical Insurance Catalogue, its price
drops from RMB256 per unit to RMB156 per unit, and nearly half of the therapeutic costs are saved when compared with
the originally developed similar proton pump inhibitors (PPI). Although the price is lowered, after being included into the
National Medical Insurance Catalogue, the sales of the product accelerated significantly, and the medical coverage increased
remarkably, which will have positive effects on the operation results of the Company. Moreover, the Company will also
continue to innovate, research and develop innovative drugs and complex drug preparations with high barriers and generic
drug varieties required urgently in clinical application and with a certain amount of high added-value. Deeper exploration
will be made on existing products under production with market potential and technical barriers. Reassessment of key drugs
after their market launch and consistency evaluation of the relevant drugs will be promoted actively. Composition of product
portfolios will be continuously optimized.

3.      Risk of research and development for new drugs
In general, pharmaceutical products are required to go through many processes and stages from research and development
to market launch, including pre-clinical research, application for clinical registration, approval for clinical trials, clinical trials,
filing for production registration, on-site inspection, and approval for production, with a long cycle involving many segments,
and the approval result is subject to uncertainty, hence risk of research and development exists. Also, after the product is
successfully researched and produced, the scale of market sales may also be affected by numerous factors. On 30 March
2020, the State Administration for Market Regulation announced that the Administration Measures for Drug Registration (
藥品註冊管理辦法) will come into effect on 1 July 2020, which has encouraged research and development and innovation
in pharmaceutical products to enhance their availability: (i) by combining the development of pharmaceutical industry and
the actual needs for clinical treatment in the PRC, and by making reference to international experience, a new chapter on
accelerating the market registration procedure for drugs has been added and four accelerated channels including breakthrough
treatment drugs, conditional approval, priority in evaluation and approval, and special approval have been established; (ii)
drugs in shortage for urgent clinical use, drugs for children, drugs for rare diseases, drugs for material infectious diseases,
and other drugs listed in the Pharmaceutical Administration Law and State Council documents are clearly included in the
scope of accelerated market registration.

     3.     Risk of research and development for new drugs (Continued)
     Response measures: The Administration Measures for Drug Registration emphasizes on the orientation of clinical value,

     registration for innovative drugs. The Company will focus on innovative drugs and high-barrier complicated drug preparations,
     pay attention to unfulfilled clinical needs and invest in innovative research and development as we have always pursued in the

     proactively carry out cooperation and introduction of overseas innovative drugs, strengthen market research and evaluation of
     varieties, reinforce the process regulation and risk management of the initiation of R&D projects, and concentrate efforts and
     make key breakthroughs in the R&D of core products. At the same time, the Group’s advantages in APIs will be fully utilized
     to reinforce the integration of API and drug preparations to ensure the long-term sustainable development of the Company.

     4.     Effect of the normalization of COVID-19 pandemic
     The outbreak of novel coronavirus disease (COVID-19) at the beginning of 2020 affected the operation of the overall economy.
     During the aggravation of the pandemic, as efforts of medical professionals were more focused on frontline work to prevent
     and control the pandemic, the consultation rate of patients with other diseases had declined and the standard prescriptions
     issued by hospitals had reduced. The production and operation of the Company was also affected to a certain extent. On
     8 May 2020, the State Council issued the Guidance Opinions on the Prevention and Control of the Normalization of Novel
     Coronavirus Infection (COVID-19) that unveiled a joint prevention and control mechanism to tackle the COVID-19 pandemic,
     and confirmed that the COVID-19 pandemic was under control in China with an optimistic trend of further stabilization and
     the prevention and control tasks have been changed from an emergency state to a normalized state. However, the pandemic
     continued to spread overseas.On 30 December 2020, the National Health Commission issued a document stating that the
     spread of COVID-19 had accelerated, and the pandemic situation in China was sporadic and overlapping with local clusters.
     As such, the situation of prevention and control was difficult and complicated. During the new year’s day and Spring Festival,
     the number of people returned to the country from abroad increases, the mobility of people within the country is high, in
     addition, there are more gathering activities, especially indoor activities, and the logistics of imported cold chain food and
     goods increases. All of the above will increase the risk of spreading COVID-19. On 30 December 2020, the General Office of
     the Ministry of Commerce issued four prevention and control guidelines, including “Technical Guidelines for Prevention and
     Control of the Pandemic in Shopping Malls and Supermarkets” (《商場、超市疫情防控技術指南》).
